convention: the fields are b[n] = conj(a[-n mod N]) of Optilux's fields a, in sqrt(W): Optilux solves the equation of the carrier exp(+j w t) (the higher frequencies at the positive bins, the phases exp(-j beta z) and exp(-j gamma |A|^2 z)), comnum the same system for the conjugate of the field reversed in time, which keeps every frequency at its bin; the conjugate alone reverses the frequency axis and the sign of beta3
fields_recorded: input; span_5_asymm, the example's step type (the nonlinear step then the linear step); span_1_symm and span_5_symm, the same link with steptype symm

link.equation: the Manakov equation of the unique-field mode (8/9 gamma), no PMD
link.steps: fiber's defaults: the first step bounded by the four-wave-mixing phase 20 x 1.5^2 rad over the sampling bandwidth (Musetti et al. 2018), the constant local error after it, dzmax 20 km, the nonlinear step on the effective length of the step; the compensating fibre in one step (its dzmax beyond its length)

name: dm_link
script: tools/record_optilux_dm.m: the chain of Examples/ex19_opt_dm_link.m on 64 symbols instead of 1024 (the step rule depends on the sampling rate, not on the block)
signal: OOK through Optilux's iqmodulator, 10 GBd, the costails pulse of roll-off 0.2 at 32 samples per symbol, 3 dBm, 64 symbols, seed 1 (Optilux's pattern); the y polarisation empty
